## We are Archroma

Archroma is a global, diversified provider of specialty chemicals serving the branded and
performance textiles, packaging and paper, and coatings, adhesives and sealants markets.

Headquartered in Pratteln, Switzerland, the company operates a highly integrated, customer-focused
platform that delivers specialized performance and color solutions in over **90 **countries.

Archroma works with over **4,000** employees in **42** countries and with over **30** production
sites.

[ Textile Effects ][155][ Packaging Technologies ][156]

## Textile Effects

From fiber to end article, Archroma’s Textile Effects division play a crucial role throughout the
textile supply chain, offering innovative solutions for pretreatment, dyeing, printing and
finishing.

Whether it’s casual wear, home textiles, automotive, or specialty technical textiles, we enhance the
aesthetics and durability, while prioritizing the well-being of both people and the planet.

Through our PLANET CONSCIOUS+ approach, we partner with you on your journey, helping you stay ahead
of industry trends. Together, we can build a more sustainable future for the textile industry.

[ Explore Textile Effects ][157]
Go deeper:

### Casual Wear

As your go-to partner in casual wear innovation, we have technologies and solutions that will drive
value with enhanced functionality, eye-catching aesthetics and sustainable differentiation.

][161]
[

### Performance Wear

With the rising demand for sportswear, activewear, outdoor clothing and athletic apparel, we have
technologies and solutions to help brands and mills stay ahead.

][162]
[

### Home Textiles

As your expert partner in home textiles, you can stay ahead with our innovative technologies and
solutions that balances performance and sustainability.

][163]
[

### Denim

As the leader in denim innovation, we bring you the broadest array of possibilities in colors and
effects with the highest quality and sustainability.

][164]
[

### Workwear and Uniforms

Archroma has the expertise and solutions to help you manufacture workwear and uniforms that meet the
highest standards of safety and performance.

][165]
[

### Exterior Textiles

We bring our innovation and expertise to help you develop products that combine performance, market
appeal and meet regulatory standards.

][166]
[

### Automotive

As a pioneer in the industry, we partner with automotive brands and suppliers worldwide to deliver
high-performance solutions for auto interiors.

][167]
[

### Nonwoven

With our expertise, innovation and commitment to sustainability, we develop cutting-edge
technologies and solutions to meet your needs for nonwovens.

][168]
[

### Swimwear

Performance, the perfect fit, vibrant colors and high-contrast patterns are key in this segment, we
have the right solutions to help you meet the needs of consumers

][169]
[

### Formal Wear

With breakthrough dyeing solutions, we are transforming wool dyeing and finishing to make it more
sustainable and cost-effective for mills and brands.

][170]

## Packaging Technologies

Across diverse sectors — from food and beverage, e-commerce, and luxury packaging to paints and
construction materials — we collaborate closely with customers to create tailored solutions that
address their toughest application challenges.

Our expertise in developing advanced chemistries helps deliver high-performing, sustainable
applications across a wide range of end markets, bringing color, protection, purpose, and strength
to everyday materials.

[ Explore Packaging Technologies ][171]
Go deeper:
* [ Industries ][172]
* [ Innovations ][173]
* [ Solutions ][174]
[

### Packaging

We support paper and packaging producers to develop packaging for **Paper & Board**, **Flexible
Packaging** and **Tape and Label** that are sustainable as well as functional by providing
adhesives, coatings, colorants, functional barriers, optical brighteners and process chemicals that
elevate the sustainable profile of packaging and pave the way for a future including bio-based
solutions.

][175]
[

### Tissue & Toweling Solutions

We provide coloration, process and functional chemicals, as well as food safe solutions – supporting
the development of superior performance, coloration and strength in tissue and towelling
applications.

][176]
[

### Wood

Advanced coatings that protect, strengthen, and preserve wood’s natural beauty and durability.

][177]
[

### Paints

Advanced emulsion technology for every surface – interior and exterior.

][178]
[

### Construction

Premium solutions for durable flooring, waterproofing, insulation, roofing and advanced mortar
performance.

][179]

## We are Archroma

Archroma is a global, diversified provider of specialty chemicals serving the branded and
performance textiles, packaging and paper, and coatings, adhesives and sealants markets.

Headquartered in Pratteln, Switzerland, the company operates a highly integrated, customer-focused
platform that delivers specialized performance and color solutions in over **90 **countries.

Archroma works with over **4,000** employees in **42** countries and with over **30** production
sites.

[ Textile Effects ][155][ Packaging Technologies ][156]

## Textile Effects

From fiber to end article, Archroma’s Textile Effects division play a crucial role throughout the
textile supply chain, offering innovative solutions for pretreatment, dyeing, printing and
finishing.

Whether it’s casual wear, home textiles, automotive, or specialty technical textiles, we enhance the
aesthetics and durability, while prioritizing the well-being of both people and the planet.

Through our PLANET CONSCIOUS+ approach, we partner with you on your journey, helping you stay ahead
of industry trends. Together, we can build a more sustainable future for the textile industry.

## Enriching lives through innovation

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science
and ingenuity to create innovations that play a critical role in the everyday lives of many millions
of people.

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

## Careers

### Make a difference with us

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse

## Enriching lives through innovation

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science
and ingenuity to create innovations that play a critical role in the everyday lives of many millions
of people.

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

[Product Information][112]
[Watch Video][113]

[Product Finder][114]

## Careers

### Make a difference with us

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse
range of consumer and industrial end markets. We operate more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and
operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates within
our continuing operations. For more information about Huntsman, please visit the company's website
at [www.huntsman.com][117].

Alan Chemical Industries LTD is a professional manufacturer and exporter of Dyesuff and Most
Auxiliaries of Paper, Food, Textile and Plastic. We are committed to providing our customers with

## OUR STORY

Americolor Corp, the largest and oldest carpet dye company in America, has been saving carpets from
landfills since 1978. Founded by Don and Ernest David, we pioneered sustainable dyeing with over 70
colors and innovative tools, including the first U.S.-made carpet dye machine. All of our products
are proudly manufactured in the USA, reflecting our commitment to quality and innovation. Our
mission is simple: make carpet restoration easy, effective, and accessible. With our products,
professionals and DIYers alike can bring carpets back to life—saving time, money, and millions of
yards from waste. Join us in transforming carpets and promoting sustainability, all while supporting
American-made products.

# FAQ

What products does Chemworld International manufacture and supply?

Chemworld International manufactures and supplies a full range of dyestuff and colorant solutions
including acid dyes, basic (cationic) dyes, direct dyes, disperse dyes, reactive dyes, solvent dyes,
liquid dyes, organic pigments, FD&C certified food and cosmetic colorants, optical brightening
agents (OBAs), and specialty chemicals. We serve buyers across the textile, plastics, inks,
coatings, food, cosmetics, and industrial chemicals markets.

Where is Chemworld International located and where do you ship?

Chemworld International is headquartered in Plainsboro, NJ (Princeton area) with a primary shipping
depot in Charlotte, NC. We ship same-day from domestic inventory to customers throughout the United
States and internationally — including Canada, Mexico, Europe, and Asia. For large-volume orders,
direct shipment from our overseas manufacturing plants is also available.

What is the Minimum Order Quantity?

We supply everything from small lab samples for shade evaluation and testing, to trial quantities
for small production runs, to full drum and pallet quantities for commercial production. Contact our
team for volume pricing tiers.

How long has Chemworld been in business?

Chemworld International was founded in 1995 and has been operating for over 30 years as a
manufacturer and distributor of dyes, pigments, and specialty chemicals. We are a family-owned and
operated business headquartered in New Jersey.

Can Chemworld match a customer color or develop a customer dye blend?

Yes. Chemworld's domestic lab capabilities include custom dye blending and formulation. Our
technical team can help you develop a color match for your process conditions and end-use
applications.

What industries does Chemworld serve?

We supply dyestuff and colorant solutions to a wide range of industries including: textile and
apparel, plastics and masterbatch compounding, printing inks and coatings, food, drug, and cosmetics
(FD&C), wood staining, leather finishing, paper manufacturing, oils and lubricants, car wash soaps,
optical whitening for detergents and paper, and water tracing and UV leak detection applications.

How do I request a sample or get a quote?

To get a quote --> [Contact Us][27]

What is the difference between a dye and a pigment?

Dyes are soluble colorants that dissolve in a carrier medium (water or solvent) and bond to a
substrate at a molecular level. Pigments are insoluble particles that are dispersed into a medium
and impart color through light absorption and scattering. Dyes are generally used for textiles,
leather, paper, and inks where transparency and deep fiber penetration are needed. Pigments are
preferred for plastics, coatings, and inks where opacity, heat stability, and chemical resistance
are required. Chemworld supplies both — see our Dyes and Pigments pages for full product ranges.

  turned into the soluble form and carried to the fiber. As micelles empty their dye, they can

* Hangzhou Fucai Chem Co.,Ltd developed a wide range of disperse dyes to fulfill demands of

  PES fibers. By choosing suitable pre-treatment, dyeing method and after treatment process,
  disperse dyes present effective and reliable dyeing process and fastness levels for polyester

dyestuffs, pigments and related textile auxiliaries, dyeing pigment intermediates. The main members

ten years of professional experience. In the past three years, the dyeing industry at domestic and
abroad has undergone earth-shaking changes. We've been focusing on the adjustment and implementation
of domestic policies, the changes of the dyestuff industry and production, as well as the shortage
of supply due to its subtle dynamic changes. [more >>][59]

### EKSOY KİMYA

## About Us

Eksoy was established in 1981 with the aim of supplying auxiliary chemical materials to the textile
industry.Starting operations with a small laboratory in Adana, our company has today grown into a
global organization with a total of six laboratories both domestically and internationally. Eksoy
has production facilities in Pakistan and India and is also actively operating in India and China.

In 1992, a significant step was taken in the textile dyes sector by signing a distributorship
agreement with Kisco, one of South Korea’s largest dye manufacturers. Thanks to the strong
collaboration with Kisco, a joint production facility named Kimsoy Boya Ticaret A.Ş. was established
in 1997 in the Adana Organized Industrial Zone, marking the beginning of domestic textile dye
production.

## About Us

Eksoy was established in 1981 with the aim of supplying auxiliary chemical materials to the textile
industry.Starting operations with a small laboratory in Adana, our company has today grown into a
global organization with a total of six laboratories both domestically and internationally. Eksoy
has production facilities in Pakistan and India and is also actively operating in India and China.

In 1992, a significant step was taken in the textile dyes sector by signing a distributorship
agreement with Kisco, one of South Korea’s largest dye manufacturers. Thanks to the strong
collaboration with Kisco, a joint production facility named Kimsoy Boya Ticaret A.Ş. was established
in 1997 in the Adana Organized Industrial Zone, marking the beginning of domestic textile dye

# WE ARE FASHION REVOLUTION

For over 10 years, we have been campaigning passionately for a clean, safe, fair, transparent and
accountable fashion industry. We believe in a global fashion industry that conserves and restores
the environment and values people over growth and profit.

**Thank you for Joining Us for Collective Action!**

Everyone has a part to play in building a fair, clean and safe fashion industry, but for effective
change, we must reach beyond individual actions. The most powerful solutions are already happening
in communities, collectives, and local networks – 

This year’s **Fashion Revolution Week** reclaimed the collective: standing united as one voice.

We asked revolutionaries to go back to their roots, find connection, ask questions, and take to the
streets – for both a better fashion industry and for future generations that follow in our
footsteps. 

Over 130 events where held globally for this year’s **Mend in Public Day**, with film screenings,
craft corners, textile-banner workshops, and panel discussions being just some of the ways
revolutionaries around the world came together. As a collective we learned, inspired and shared
knowledge on what needs to change in our broken fashion system.

We thank each and every one of you who took part in this year’s campaign!!

Fashion Revolution Week may be over, but this is not the end for us as a movement, as we look to our
next year of campaigning for a fashion industry that respects the planet and the people who make our
clothes – over profit.

We hope you will join us.

To continue keeping up to date with all things Fashion Revolution, sign up to our newsletter.

[SUBSCRIBE TO THE NEWSLETTER][38]

[JOIN THE FASHION REVOLUTION][39]

# WE ARE FASHION REVOLUTION

For over 10 years, we have been campaigning passionately for a clean, safe, fair, transparent and
accountable fashion industry. We believe in a global fashion industry that conserves and restores
the environment and values people over growth and profit.

**Thank you for Joining Us for Collective Action!**

Everyone has a part to play in building a fair, clean and safe fashion industry, but for effective
change, we must reach beyond individual actions. The most powerful solutions are already happening
in communities, collectives, and local networks – 

This year’s **Fashion Revolution Week** reclaimed the collective: standing united as one voice.

We asked revolutionaries to go back to their roots, find connection, ask questions, and take to the
streets – for both a better fashion industry and for future generations that follow in our
footsteps. 

Over 130 events where held globally for this year’s **Mend in Public Day**, with film screenings,
craft corners, textile-banner workshops, and panel discussions being just some of the ways
revolutionaries around the world came together. As a collective we learned, inspired and shared
knowledge on what needs to change in our broken fashion system.

We thank each and every one of you who took part in this year’s campaign!!

Fashion Revolution Week may be over, but this is not the end for us as a movement, as we look to our
next year of campaigning for a fashion industry that respects the planet and the people who make our
clothes – over profit.

We hope you will join us.

To continue keeping up to date with all things Fashion Revolution, sign up to our newsletter.

[SUBSCRIBE TO THE NEWSLETTER][38]

[JOIN THE FASHION REVOLUTION][39]

# See what your competitors

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.

  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.

  move before it's made, not after the press release.

intel.summary: [IntechOpen] * [Books][1] * [Book Series][2] * [Journals][3] * [Publish][4] * [About][5] * [News][6] * [Author Panel][7] * * [Login][8] Submit [What is Open Access?][9] Open Access is an initiative that aims to make scientific research freely available to all. To date our community has made over 100 million downloads. It’s based on principles of collaboration, unobstructed discovery, and, most importantly, scientific progression. As PhD students, we found it difficult to access the research we needed, so we decided to create a new Open Access publisher that levels the playing field for scientists across the world. How? By making research easy to access, and puts the academic needs of the researchers before the business interests of publishers. [Authors, Editors and Institutions][10] We are a community of more than 103,000 authors and editors from 3,291 institutions spanning 160 countries, including Nobel Prize winners and some of the world’s most-cited researchers. Publishing on IntechOpen allows authors to earn citations and find new collaborators, meaning more people see your work not only from your own field of study, but from other related fields too. To date our community has made over 100 million downloads. It’s based on principles of collaboration, unobstructed discovery, and, most importantly, scientific progression. As PhD students, we found it difficult to access the research we needed, so we decided to create a new Open Access publisher that levels the playing field for scientists across the world. How? By making research easy to access, and puts the academic needs of the researchers before the business interests of publishers. [Authors, Editors and Institutions][10] We are a community of more than 103,000 authors and editors from 3,291 institutions spanning 160 countries, including Nobel Prize winners and some of the world’s most-cited researchers. Publishing on IntechOpen allows authors to earn citations and find new collaborators, meaning more people see your work not only from your own field of study, but from other related fields too. [Read more][81] 25 March 2025 ##### ResearchGate and IntechOpen Announce New Journal Home Partnership As part of our ongoing commitment to expanding the reach and visibility of open access research, we are excited to announce a new partnership with ResearchGate, the leading professional network for researchers. This collaboration will increase the reach and brand visibility of our journals through ResearchGate’s Journal Home platform. [Read more][82] 08 July 2024 ##### IntechOpen Presents Interviews for Young Scientists with Science's Leading Minds We are pleased to present a series of inspirational interviews for young researchers with some of today's leading scientists, ranging from a Nobel laureate to pioneers and innovators in various fields, including pharmacogenomics, pharmaceutical leadership, and academia. [Read more][83] 22 May 2024 ##### IntechOpen Reaches New Milestone: 7,000 Books Open for All IntechOpen has achieved a significant milestone in its mission to democratise scientific knowledge by announcing the publication of its 7,000th open access book, 'Towards the Eradication of* Helicobacter pylori* Infection - Rapid Diagnosis and Precision Treatment.' Guided by the expertise of Dr Liang Wang, Dr Alfred Chin Yen Tay, and 2005 Nobel Prize Laureate Prof. Barry J. Marshall, this book offers insightful research and novel approaches, contributing to the continuous discourse on *Helicobacter pylori*-related research. [Read more][84] 11 March 2024 ##### IntechOpen Signs Open Access Institutional Agreement with Iowa State University IntechOpen signs an institutional agreement with Iowa State University of Science and Technology to support open access and cover open access publishing fees for their faculty. [Read more][85] 07 June 2023 ##### IntechOpen Becomes a UKSG Member IntechOpen is now an official member of the UKSG, the UK's largest scholarly communications community. Founded almost half a century ago, it connects the knowledge community and encourages the exchange of ideas in scholarly communication. [Read more][86] 28 March 2023 ##### IntechOpen Book Wins the 2022 International Academy of Astronautics Life Science Book Award We are thrilled that the International Academy of Astronautics has chosen IntechOpen's book "Preparation of Space Experiments", edited by Dr. Vladimir Pletser, to receive the IAA Life Science Book Award. The award is given annually to recognize excellence in publication by an Academy member or corresponding member in the field of life sciences. Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

experience.

stand out as both entertaining and unnerving.

**Fast Editorial Execution and Review Process (FEE-Review Process):**

Journal of Chemical and Pharmaceutical Research is participating in the Fast Editorial Execution and
Review Process (FEE-Review Process) with an additional prepayment of $99 apart from the regular
article processing fee. Fast Editorial Execution and Review Process is a special service for the
article that enables it to get a faster response in the pre-review stage from the handling editor as
well as a review from the reviewer. An author can get a faster response of pre-review maximum in 3
days since submission, and a review process by the reviewer maximum in 5 days, followed by
revision/publication in 2 days. If the article gets notified for revision by the handling editor,
then it will take another 5 days for external review by the previous reviewer or alternative
reviewer.

Acceptance of manuscripts is driven entirely by handling editorial team considerations and
independent peer-review, ensuring the highest standards are maintained no matter the route to
regular peer-reviewed publication or a fast editorial review process. The handling editor and the
article contributor are responsible for adhering to scientific standards. The article FEE-Review
process of $99 will not be refunded even if the article is rejected or withdrawn for publication.

The corresponding author or institution/organization is responsible for making the manuscript
FEE-Review Process payment. The additional FEE-Review Process payment covers the fast review
processing and quick editorial decisions, and regular article publication covers the preparation in
various formats for online publication, securing full-text inclusion in a number of permanent
archives like HTML, XML, and PDF, and feeding to different indexing agencies.

#### h-index

Articles published in **Journal of Chemical and Pharmaceutical Research** have been cited by
esteemed scholars and scientists all around the world. **Journal of Chemical and Pharmaceutical
Research** has got h-index 66 , which means every article in Journal of Chemical and Pharmaceutical
Research has got 66 average citations.

Chemistry, Agricultural & Soil Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Polymer Chemistry, Macromolecular

**Fast Editorial Execution and Review Process (FEE-Review Process):**

Journal of Chemical and Pharmaceutical Research is participating in the Fast Editorial Execution and
Review Process (FEE-Review Process) with an additional prepayment of $99 apart from the regular
article processing fee. Fast Editorial Execution and Review Process is a special service for the
article that enables it to get a faster response in the pre-review stage from the handling editor as
well as a review from the reviewer. An author can get a faster response of pre-review maximum in 3
days since submission, and a review process by the reviewer maximum in 5 days, followed by
revision/publication in 2 days. If the article gets notified for revision by the handling editor,
then it will take another 5 days for external review by the previous reviewer or alternative
reviewer.

Acceptance of manuscripts is driven entirely by handling editorial team considerations and
independent peer-review, ensuring the highest standards are maintained no matter the route to
regular peer-reviewed publication or a fast editorial review process. The handling editor and the
article contributor are responsible for adhering to scientific standards. The article FEE-Review
process of $99 will not be refunded even if the article is rejected or withdrawn for publication.

The corresponding author or institution/organization is responsible for making the manuscript
FEE-Review Process payment. The additional FEE-Review Process payment covers the fast review
processing and quick editorial decisions, and regular article publication covers the preparation in
various formats for online publication, securing full-text inclusion in a number of permanent
archives like HTML, XML, and PDF, and feeding to different indexing agencies.

## Pre-Preg Products

Pacific Coast Composites is an authorized distributor for Hexcel pre-pregs and ISOVOLTA pre-pregs.

View [Hexcel Pre-Pregs][107], [ISOVOLTA Pre-Pregs][108], and [ISOVOLTA Airpreg][109]

## Who We Are

The biggest frustration of our customers is finding the right products, in the right quantities, and
getting them in their hands as fast as possible. Due to the exacting tolerances and requirements of
advanced composite materials, the industry as a whole is not set up to meet the needs of smaller
quantities and fast turn around.

With more than 30 years of experience in the composites industry, our management and staff are
committed to delivering the highest quality products, unsurpassed customer service, competitive
pricing, and rapid action response to your critical needs. Many of our advanced composites
are stocked in our freezer and shipped same day.

[ More About Us ][117]

Keyword

# Protective.
# Emotive.
# Demand both.

From automotive and aerospace to coil and specialty, we engineer coatings and surface solutions that
protect and inspire.

[ About us ][60]
[ What we do ][61]
Image
[People on tank]

## Over 130 years of expertise. A new beginning.

We are Surventis - formerly known as BASF Coatings - a global leader in automotive coatings and
surface treatment. Following the agreement between BASF and Carlyle, we have become an independent,
standalone company: a new identity, built on continuity.

Our new chapter builds on the foundations that have made us strong: deep technical expertise,
long-standing customer relationships, trusted heritage brands, and a culture shaped over more than
130 years. As an independent company, we now move with greater entrepreneurial freedom, faster
decision-making and agility, backed by Carlyle's global network and commitment to our growth.

[ Press Release ][62]

## What defines us

Our intelligent coatings help customers shine in their markets. We anticipate global trends and
identify opportunities that shape the future of industries. We meet the highest technical and
quality demands in an aesthetically pleasing, environmentally friendly way, combining design with
functionality. Our work in research, production and service is reliable worldwide.

### Driven by passion and science

Built on BASF's heritage with a more entrepreneurial future, we foster an inspiring exchange across
diverse perspectives.

[ Careers ][64]

### Merging science and beauty

Close collaboration, global presence, expertise and innovation are the pillars of our commercial
success.

[ About us ][65]

### Reliable worldwide

Around 10,000 employees at our more than 70 sites of Surventis are ready to serve, wherever you are
located.

[ Locations ][66]
Image
[Purple automotive coating]

## What we do

We engineer coatings and surface solutions, from treatment to refinish, across automotive and many
other industries. Working with us means going further to solve even your most challenging needs.
[
Image
[back 3/4 view of a white car with a sunset in the background] ][67]

### Automotive

Our solutions support a broad range of vehicle categories and powertrain concepts, helping
manufacturers, suppliers, body builders and bodyshops create the surfaces that keep the automotive
world moving.
[Learn more][68]
[
Image
[airplane flying view from inside window of aircraft, flying above the clouds during sunset] ][69]

### Aerospace

With decades of aerospace experience and a broad portfolio of OEM approved technologies, we support
a wide range of aircraft types and applications.
[Learn more][70]
[
Image
[detail of steel coils in warehouse] ][71]

### Coil

We support the coil industry with surface treatment and advanced application technologies that
prepare and protect metal before it is shaped and coated.
[Learn more][72]
[
Image
[motorcycles parked in row in various colors] ][73]

### Specialty

From a perfectly smooth piano finish to precise optical components and durable motorcycle surfaces,
we help each surface perform as intended in its own context.
[Learn more][74]
Image
[White]

## What sets us apart

From the world's most advanced color expertise to award-winning sustainable innovation, these are
some of the capabilities that make us a partner unlike any other.

### Refinity® – a seamless digital experience for bodyshops

Our cloud-based platform brings together a full suite of digital solutions for automotive refinish,
helping body shops worldwide work faster, more sustainably and with the most advanced digital color
experience available.
[Discover Refinity®][76]
[
Image
[Tesseract blue] ][77]

### Automotive Color Trends – DRIVING THE PROXY

Each year our designers shape the colors of tomorrow's vehicles. Our latest collection draws on
design, nature and technology, with sustainable materials and innovations like multi-color pigments
and liquid-metal surfaces.
[Explore the collection][78]
[
Image
[Automotive color display] ][79]

### The world's largest color databases

Decades of color expertise, captured in one of the world's largest databases. It lets us match and
reproduce virtually any shade with precision, whether designing tomorrow's vehicles or restoring
today's.
[Our color expertise][80]
[
Image
[R-M expert] ][81]

### Trusted heritage brands

Behind Surventis stands a portfolio of brands the industry has relied on for generations. Glasurit®,
with over 130 years of refinish expertise, and R-M®, with more than a century of color leadership,
are recognized by bodyshops and manufacturers worldwide, alongside specialist brands like baslac®
and Norbin®. These names carry a legacy of quality that continues into our new chapter.
[Meet our brands][82]

### [ Surventis launches as an independent global leader in automotive coatings and surface
### treatment ][84]

MUENSTER, Germany, July 1, 2026. Surventis, formerly BASF Coatings, today launched as an independent
company, completing its carve-out from BASF. With around €3.9 billion in annual sales and around
10,700 employees, Surventis is one of the world’s leading suppliers of automotive coatings and
surface treatment solutions. The business is majority-owned by funds managed by global investment
firm Carlyle (NASDAQ: CG) in partnership with Qatar Investment Authority. BASF holds a 40% stake in
Surventis.
Jul 1, 2026
[[Image of the executive committee of Surventis] ][85]

### [ BASF Coatings names Executive Committee to lead and drive success as a standalone company
### ][86]

MUENSTER, Germany, June 25, 2026. BASF Coatings today named the leadership team that will run the
business as an independent company from July 1, 2026, after the closing of the transaction. The new
structure brings together leaders who have built the coatings business over many years and senior
executives with proven records in finance, digital and transformation. The Executive Committee will
be led by incoming Chief Executive Officer Jens Luehring.
Jun 26, 2026

[ About us ][60]

## Over 130 years of expertise. A new beginning.

We are Surventis - formerly known as BASF Coatings - a global leader in automotive coatings and
surface treatment. Following the agreement between BASF and Carlyle, we have become an independent,
standalone company: a new identity, built on continuity.

Our new chapter builds on the foundations that have made us strong: deep technical expertise,
long-standing customer relationships, trusted heritage brands, and a culture shaped over more than
130 years. As an independent company, we now move with greater entrepreneurial freedom, faster
decision-making and agility, backed by Carlyle's global network and commitment to our growth.

[ Press Release ][62]

## What defines us

Our intelligent coatings help customers shine in their markets. We anticipate global trends and
identify opportunities that shape the future of industries. We meet the highest technical and
quality demands in an aesthetically pleasing, environmentally friendly way, combining design with
functionality. Our work in research, production and service is reliable worldwide.

### Driven by passion and science

Built on BASF's heritage with a more entrepreneurial future, we foster an inspiring exchange across
diverse perspectives.

### Trusted heritage brands

Behind Surventis stands a portfolio of brands the industry has relied on for generations. Glasurit®,

are recognized by bodyshops and manufacturers worldwide, alongside specialist brands like baslac®
and Norbin®. These names carry a legacy of quality that continues into our new chapter.

### [ Surventis launches as an independent global leader in automotive coatings and surface
### treatment ][84]

MUENSTER, Germany, July 1, 2026. Surventis, formerly BASF Coatings, today launched as an independent
company, completing its carve-out from BASF. With around €3.9 billion in annual sales and around
10,700 employees, Surventis is one of the world’s leading suppliers of automotive coatings and
surface treatment solutions. The business is majority-owned by funds managed by global investment
firm Carlyle (NASDAQ: CG) in partnership with Qatar Investment Authority. BASF holds a 40% stake in
Surventis.

MUENSTER, Germany, June 25, 2026. BASF Coatings today named the leadership team that will run the

executives with proven records in finance, digital and transformation. The Executive Committee will

audience.

textiles. I want to bridge the gap between technical expertise and creative expression, ensuring
that even the most complex topics are presented in an approachable and engaging manner.

## [Mohammd (Anik) Yousuf][53]

**Founder, TextileTuts**

As a textile engineer with a bachelor’s degree from Ahsanullah University of Science & Technology,
I’ve always had a deep love for everything related to textiles. After spending three rewarding years
as a Production Engineer at Knit Concern LTD, a leading composite garment factory, I decided to
combine my passion for blogging and textiles to create something truly special.

TextileTuts.com is my brainchild, born out of a desire to share my knowledge and engage with a wider
audience.

With TextileTuts.com, my mission is to empower individuals to explore the fascinating world of
textiles. I want to bridge the gap between technical expertise and creative expression, ensuring
that even the most complex topics are presented in an approachable and engaging manner.

Whether you’re a student, a professional, or simply captivated by the artistry of fabrics, I invite
you to join me on this enlightening journey through the intricate realm of textiles. Together, let’s
unravel the wonders and possibilities that this industry holds.

## [Companies and Markets][98]

[

### Niber Technologies: Ingredient Brand Strategy for Its PFAS-Free Electrospinning Platform

Niber Technologies, Southeast Asia’s first industrial-scale manufacturer of PFAS-free electrospun
nanofiber membranes, announced a strategic collaboration with BRAIND®, the specialist consultancy
for ingredient brand strategy. As part of the partnership, BRAIND Managing Director Tomas
Vucurevic—widely recognized as one of the world’s leading experts in ingredient branding—has been
appointed Chief Brand Advisor to Niber Technologies. The move signals Niber’s intent to expand its
platform beyond materials into a structured ingredient brand, scaling its role as the industry moves
toward next-generation performance and material efficiency. 

][99]
[

### Irish government publishes Delivery Plan for textiles EPR scheme

The Irish government has published its draft Delivery Plan for its national textiles Extended
Producer Responsibility (EPR) scheme – subject to a stakeholder consultation.  

The draft plan outlines the actions required for the effective design and go-live of a national
textiles Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) scheme, including the establishment of an entirely
new Producer Responsibility Organisation (PRO) in Ireland, required by April 2028.

Commenting, Aimee Campanella, Development Director – Textiles EPR at leading international
circularity specialists Reconomy, said: “It is great to see the Irish Government making progress
towards establishing a national textiles Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) scheme.”

“The proposed April 2028 go-live date gives textile producers time to prepare, but businesses should
be using this period to understand what the new scheme will mean for their operations and how they
can put the right systems in place.

][100]
[

### ISKO: Conscious color, texture, and tactile evolution to Bluezone Munich

At Bluezone ISKO is debuting its FW 27–28 Collection, structured around a trio of core sensory
pillars: color, texture, and touch. This season, the textile leader showcases a creative vision
where emotional connection and advanced technical innovation come together. The entire range is
anchored by a dedicated commitment to eco-conscious material creation, utilizing patented processing
technologies and high-quality Next-Gen materials powered by RE&UP. 

ISKO FW27–28 collection: Supreme Colors and beyond 
Anchoring the new season is Supreme Colors, a concept that highlights ISKO’s deep mastery of color
innovation through a broad and adaptable shade spectrum spanning various product lines. Enhanced by
strong yarn character, fast fading properties, and laser-compatible finishing techniques, the range
delivers a high-definition visual depth alongside authentic, vintage denim characteristics. 

][101]
[

### RE&UP now B Corp™ certified

The milestone solidifies the company’s commitment to transparent, textile-to-textile manufacturing
across the global value chain. 

RE&UP, the circular-tech transforming global textile waste into high-volume Next-Gen materials, has
officially become a Certified B Corporation™. 

The milestone establishes the industrial recycler among a select group of manufacturing
infrastructure providers verified as meeting B Lab Standards for social and environmental
performance, transparency, and accountability. 

"Today marks an important milestone for RE&UP as we become a Certified B Corporation™. This
certification reflects our commitment to building an infrastructure where innovation, circularity,
and operational responsibility operate in unison. It recognizes not only what we do, transforming
textile waste into high-purity resources, but also how we do it: with transparency, accountability,
and a long-term vision. This achievement is a testament to our team's collective effort, and we
remain dedicated to driving systemic, meaningful change across the global value chain." Said Ebru
Özküçük Güler, Chief Sustainability Officer, RE&UP 

][102]
[

### eVent Fabrics & PELLIOT: Lower-Impact Innovation in the Global Outdoor Market

In a big win for lower impact products, eVent Fabrics, a global leader in waterproof and breathable
fabric technologies, is partnering with PELLIOT, one of China’s fastest-growing outdoor brands, to
bring their flagship PFAS-free alpineST and windstormST laminates to the rapidly expanding China
outdoor market. Founded in 2012, PELLIOT is a leading Chinese high-performance outdoor lifestyle
brand. The company has a long history of supporting elite mountaineers and explorers in scaling the
world’s highest peaks and conducting expeditions of significant scientific value.

PFAS in functional textiles has become a significant industry concern, making the transition to
PFAS-free materials a clear market imperative. PELLIOT specializes in high-performance outdoor gear
for mountaineering, travel, hiking, and skiing. Through this partnership with eVent Fabrics, PELLIOT
is expanding its next-generation product range, further cementing its position as an industry
benchmark for functional outdoor apparel.

][103]
[

### AkzoNobel’s Russian subsidiaries placed under temporary external administration

AkzoNobel has taken note of a presidential decree signed by the President of Russia placing the
company’s Russian subsidiaries under temporary external administration as of July 13.
 
Under temporary external administration, operational oversight is transferred to a designated
external entity, while underlying ownership remains unchanged. AkzoNobel is currently reviewing the
decree and assessing its implications. Russia represents less than 2% of AkzoNobel’s revenue and is
not material to the company’s overall financial performance.
 
The company remains committed to supporting its employees and safeguarding its interests as
shareholder of AkzoNobel’s Russian subsidiaries.
 
Following the EU sanctions introduced in 2022, AkzoNobel discontinued a significant part of its
activities in Russia. The remaining operations have since been fully localized and ringfenced,
operating independently without financial support from Akzo Nobel N.V.

 

][104]
[

### ALADIN: Circular and demand-driven textile production in Europe

Textile production can be organized sustainably by utilizing short supply chains and preventing
overproduction. This can already be achieved today by intelligently connecting and efficiently
utilizing existing infrastructure. At the same time, production becomes circular when innovative
technologies and materials are used that enable high-quality recycling. The ALADIN research project,
launched in May 2026 and co-funded with five million euros under the EU Horizon Europe program, is
creating the conditions for this.

Under the coordination of the German Institutes of Textile and Fiber Research Denkendorf (DITF), ten
European project partners are developing and integrating platforms, technologies, and viable
business models for circular textile production over four years. ALADIN stands for Advanced LocAl
and Digital Innovation Network for Circular Garme

textiles Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) scheme, including the establishment of an entirely
new Producer Responsibility Organisation (PRO) in Ireland, required by April 2028.

circularity specialists Reconomy, said: “It is great to see the Irish Government making progress
towards establishing a national textiles Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) scheme.”

across the global value chain.

brand. The company has a long history of supporting elite mountaineers and explorers in scaling the

### AkzoNobel’s Russian subsidiaries placed under temporary external administration

AkzoNobel has taken note of a presidential decree signed by the President of Russia placing the
company’s Russian subsidiaries under temporary external administration as of July 13.
 
Under temporary external administration, operational oversight is transferred to a designated
external entity, while underlying ownership remains unchanged. AkzoNobel is currently reviewing the
decree and assessing its implications. Russia represents less than 2% of AkzoNobel’s revenue and is
not material to the company’s overall financial performance.
 
The company remains committed to supporting its employees and safeguarding its interests as
shareholder of AkzoNobel’s Russian subsidiaries.
 
Following the EU sanctions introduced in 2022, AkzoNobel discontinued a significant part of its
activities in Russia. The remaining operations have since been fully localized and ringfenced,
operating independently without financial support from Akzo Nobel N.V.

### ALADIN: Circular and demand-driven textile production in Europe

Textile production can be organized sustainably by utilizing short supply chains and preventing
overproduction. This can already be achieved today by intelligently connecting and efficiently
utilizing existing infrastructure. At the same time, production becomes circular when innovative
technologies and materials are used that enable high-quality recycling. The ALADIN research project,
launched in May 2026 and co-funded with five million euros under the EU Horizon Europe program, is
creating the conditions for this.

Under the coordination of the German Institutes of Textile and Fiber Research Denkendorf (DITF), ten
European project partners are developing and integrating platforms, technologies, and viable
business models for circular textile production over four years. ALADIN stands for Advanced LocAl
and Digital Innovation Network for Circular Garme

Popular Textile Dyes Series

### Disperse Dyes
* [
  
  ### E Type
  
  The Taicron E series is distinguished by its ability to effectively dye pale shades due to its
  excellent leveling property, and it's designed for low-temperature, and rapid dyeing of polyester.
  
  ][64]
* [
  
  ### SE Type
  
  Taicron SE series offers better sublimation fastness than the E-type, alongside good levelling
  properties for medium to deep shades and excellent reproducibility. It's also suitable for
  exhaustion dyeing and printing.
  
  ][65]
* [
  
  ### SF Type
  
  Taicron SF is an economical option. It offers a wide range of applications in rapid, and
  exhaustion dyeing and printing, with better washing fastness performance than the SE series.
  
  ][66]
* [
  
  ### XF Type
  
  The XF Series stands out with superior washing fastness as per Marks & Spencer C4A standards and
  unmatched sublimation properties. particularly for polyester fiber.
  
  ][67]
* [
  
  ### SP Type
  
  The Taicron SP Series, developed for Polyester and spandex blended fabrics, shows outstanding
  performance in washing fastness tests, especially in deep shades. The dyestuff has perfect
  build-up properties and operates best in a dyeing pH range of 3.8 to 4.5.
  
  ][68]
* [
  
  ### Fluorescent Dyes
  
  Fluorescent series is suitable for bright and vivid colors.
  
  ][69]
* [
  
  ### HW Type
  
  Taicron HW-T is economic dye series with high washing fastness, quick buildup, with wide pH range
  4-8, mainly for medium to dark shades. It offers better colorfastness to washing than the SF type
  and is suitable for exhaustion dyeing, continuous and rapid dyeing, and printing.
  
  ][70]

### Basic Dyes
* [
  
  ### Acrylic Series
  
  Taiacryl Dyes, marked by T&T Industries Corporation, is cationic dyes for dyeing acrylic fibers,
  which is applicable to exhaustion dyeing. They have brilliant shades, excellent fastness and very
  good build-up property.
  
  ][71]
* [
  
  ### AD Type Series
  
  Taiacryl AD Colors are disperse - types with anionic character. Therefore, Taiacryl AD Colors can
  provide a great advantage in the dyeing of acrylic fiber blends or cationic dyeable polyester
  fiber and its blends, which can be quite compatible with other anionic compounds. Therefore,
  Taiacryl AD Colors are suitable for one bath one step dyeing.
  
  ][72]
* [
  
  ### CD Type Series
  
  Taiacryl CD Colors are specially selected from cationic dyes for dyeing of cationic dyeable
  polyester fiber with a good stability in high dyeing temperature at 120°C. Taiacryl CD Colors show
  a cationic character, therefore, Taiacryl CD Colors are not suitable for one bath one step dyeing
  with anionic compounds, unless Anti-precipitating agent is added during dyeing. The main advantage
  of using CD dyes is the strength of CD dyes is much stronger than of AD dyes. CD dyes allow for a
  very dark shades.
  
  ][73]

### Acid Dyes
* [
  
  ### Taiacid
  
  Acid dyes for polyamide and wool fibers dyeing, applicable for exhaustion dyeing, which enable
  dyer to achieve perfect results on a wide variety of fabrics of polyamide staple fibers and
  filaments.
  
  ][74]
* [
  
  ### KWL type
  
  Suitable for 100% polyamide and wool in pale shade, which have outstanding levelling to avoid
  streaky dyeing.
  
  ][75]

# Weaving quality narrow fabrics since 1910

[Explore All Products][89]

**Wayne Mills** has spent 110 years weaving high quality twill tapes and light webbings. Our
state-of-the-art equipment and dedicated employees assure a consistent product, which our customers
demand and few of our competitors can match. Our ability to manufacture high quality tapes coupled
with our high-speed bleaching range, on-site dyehouse, extensive finishing capabilities, textile
design service, and a broad array of additional service offerings allow us to fine-tune our textile
and fabric product to meet your needs.

## Products

Explore a broad selection of [narrow fabric][90] products. Many items are kept in stock, enabling
fast delivery of goods. Some of our most popular product types are listed below, or you can view all
to filter for your specific needs.

  Custom narrow Fabrics

[View All Products][91]

## Applications

We manufacture fabric products that can be used for many different applications across various
industries and specialty trades. Explore the Application pages to find webbings and tapes tailored
to meet the needs of your industry.

### Featured Applications

  Apparel

  Bindings

  Military Specification

  Bags & Straps

## Services

Choose from these specialty services. Each is carried out in our state-of-the-art facilities by
experienced members of the Wayne Mills team, so you can be sure that your products are being made
with care.
* Textile Design Services
* Narrow Fabric Bleaching
* Custom Dyeing & Lab Dips
* Reflective Lamination
* Custom Coating
* Custom Cutting, Put Ups & Packaging

[View Services][93]

## Why Wayne Mills?

[Graphic icon of a clock face with dots.]
**Fast Turnaround Times**

Wayne Mills’ extensive inventory allows us to cut down your lead time, so you receive orders sooner
without sacrificing quality or attention to detail. Note: Custom orders are also available and
promptly fulfilled.

[Icon of a person symbol above an open hand.]
**Superior Customer Service**

Our experienced team is known for personalized and professional service. Many of our team members
have been with us for more than 25 years. We pride ourselves on providing prompt and knowledgeable
assistance to all customers.

[Outline of three water droplets.]
**Small Dye Lot Minimum**

Skein dying and other custom dyes require a minimum order of just 15 pounds. Although the industry
standard is 500-1000 pounds, we want to ensure that your order can be fulfilled no matter what
specifications you require.

different dyes, pigments, chemical auxiliaries, and intermediates, which are widely applied in

Industrial Park, Xiqing Economic Development Area, Tianjin, China, and currently employs several
hundred staff members. Xiangrui specializes in the manufacture and supply of a wide range of
different dyes, pigments, chemical auxiliaries, and intermediates, which are widely applied in
industries such as textiles, papermaking, leather, coatings, inks, plastics, rubber, aluminum,
